App.Subtitle: Local AI workshop for Windows
Home.Headline: Prepare space for local AI
Home.Description: AI_HUB will store models, results, and service files on the drives you choose. Nothing is downloaded or changed without your confirmation.
Home.ModelsStorageEmpty: Choose a drive and limit for future downloads.
Home.ResultsStorageEmpty: Keep generated files separate from models and cache.
Home.ComputerPassportEmpty: Check RAM, GPU, VRAM, and free space.
Setup.Title: AI HUB setup
Setup.Description: This is a preparation page for the future setup wizard. For now, the program only creates the computer passport and does not change system settings.
Setup.PriorityHint: The first address is used by default. Other addresses can be selected manually later where needed.
Setup.StorageHelp: Add a path manually or choose a Windows folder. The nearby field is this address limit in GB.
Setup.AddressTooltip: You can paste or type the path manually
Setup.LocationLimitTooltip: Limit for this address in GB
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Description: General AI HUB settings will be here. For now, only interface language is available.
Settings.LanguageHelp: You can choose a built-in language or add your own translation JSON file to the user localization folder.
WorkStart.Title: Start work
WorkStart.ReasoningDescription: Explore a topic, ask questions, study materials, keep a working dialog, and save results.
WorkStart.PreviousExampleName: Study: "How to choose a local AI model"
WorkStart.ContinueTooltip: Continuing previous projects will be added later
Status.Initial: Status: start window prototype. Model downloads and setting changes are not active yet.
Status.WorkModeNotReady: Status: work mode is not implemented yet. Use Reconfigure to change parameters.
Status.WorkStartOpened: Status: choose a work mode or expand previous work.
Status.ReasoningModeNotReady: Status: Reasoning / study mode will be connected in the next stage.
Status.PreviousWorkExpanded: Status: showing an example of the future previous projects list.
Status.PassportReadySetupComplete: Status: setup is complete. You can start work or change parameters with Reconfigure.
Status.PassportReadySetupIncomplete: Status: computer passport is ready. Setup is not complete yet.
Status.PassportMissing: Status: computer passport has not been created yet. Open setup to retry analysis.
Status.PassportRegenerated: Status: computer passport was recreated. Setup is still a placeholder.
Status.SetupOpened: Status: setup page is open. Real parameter changes are not active yet.
Status.SetupOpenFailed: Status: failed to open setup or update the computer passport.
Status.SettingsOpened: Status: general settings page is open.
Status.StorageSavedComplete: Status: setup is complete. Storage settings were saved to {0}.
Status.StorageSavedIncomplete: Status: settings saved, but setup requires at least one model address and one results address.
Status.PathRequired: Status: specify a storage path first.
